system.description:
Tier 2 enchantment — Object no larger than you, not worn by a creature

You may place this enchantment on any object that is no larger than you and is not being worn by a creature. The object size is halved.
If the object is a two-handed weapon, its burden becomes one-handed and it loses any features it had previously, then gains the Unreliable feature.
Unreliable: -2 to attack and damage rolls.
If the object is a one-handed primary weapon or a secondary weapon, it becomes too small to be used as a weapon.
